query.ejb-ql: SELECT OBJECT (c) FROM CaseProsecutorAgency c WHERE c.caseId = ?1 AND (c.obsInd is null OR c.obsInd = 'N' OR c.obsInd = ' ')
SELECT OBJECT (c) FROM CaseProsecutorAgency c WHERE c.refProsecutorAgencyId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT (c) FROM CaseProsecutorAgency c WHERE c.refProsecutorAgencyId = ?1 AND c.caseId = ?2
SELECT OBJECT (pros) FROM ProsecutorRefSolFirm pros WHERE pros.caseProsAgencyId = ?1 AND (pros.obsInd is null OR pros.obsInd = 'N' OR pros.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY pros.prosecutorRefSolFirmId DESC

SELECT OBJECT (pros) FROM ProsecutorRefSolFirm pros WHERE pros.legalAidOrderId is not null AND pros.legalAidOrderId = ?1 AND (pros.obsInd is null OR pros.obsInd = 'N' OR pros.obsInd = ' ') ORDERBY pros.prosecutorRefSolFirmId DESC
Select object (o) from RefCalendar AS o where o.courtId = ?1 AND o.calDate BETWEEN ?2 AND ?3 order by o.calDate
Select object (o) from RefCalendar AS o where o.calDate >= ?1 AND o.courtId = ?2
Select object (o) from RefJudge AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefJudge AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1 AND o.crestJudgeId = ?2
Select object (o) from RefJudge AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1 AND o.statsCode = ?2
Select object (o) from RefJudgeTicket o where o.judgeId = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
Select object (o) from RefCourtReporter AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefAppResD20Map AS o where o.appResultCode = ?1 AND (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from RefAppResD20Map AS o where (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from RefHearingType AS o where o.courtId = ?1 AND o.category = ?2 AND (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from RefListingData AS o where o.refDataType = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
Select object (o) from RefListingData AS o where o.refDataType = ?1 and o.refDataValue = ?2 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
Select object (o) from RefHateSentencingType AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
SELECT OBJECT(r) from RefProsecutorAgency AS r WHERE r.refProsecutorAgencyId = ?1 AND (r.obsInd is null OR r.obsInd = 'N' OR r.obsInd = ' ')
SELECT object (o) from RefProsecutorAgency AS o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
SELECT object (o) from RefProsecutorAgency AS o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND lower(o.prosecutorName3) LIKE lower(?2) AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
SELECT object (o) from RefProsecutorAgency AS o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND lower(o.cpsCode) LIKE lower(?2) AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')

SELECT object (o) from RefProsecutorAgency AS o WHERE o.courtId = ?1 AND lower(o.prosecutorName3) LIKE lower(?2) AND lower(o.cpsCode) LIKE lower(?3) AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ')
Select object (o) from RefSolicitorFirm AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefLegalRepresentative AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.court.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefOffence AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefAdvocate AS o where o.legalRepId = ?1

Select object (ra) from RefAdvocate AS ra, RefLegalRepresentative AS rlr WHERE ra.barNo = ?1 AND rlr.courtId = ?2 AND ra.isGlobal = 'Y' AND (ra.obsInd is null OR ra.obsInd = 'N' OR ra.obsInd = ' ') AND ra.legalRepId = rlr.refLegalRepId AND (rlr.obsInd is null OR rlr.obsInd = 'N' OR rlr.obsInd = ' ')

Select distinct object (ra) from RefAdvocate AS ra, RefLegalRepresentative AS rlr WHERE UPPER (rlr.surname) LIKE UPPER (?1) AND UPPER (rlr.initials) LIKE UPPER (?2) AND rlr.courtId = ?3 AND ra.isGlobal = 'Y' AND ra.legalRepId = rlr.refLegalRepId ORDER BY rlr.surname, rlr.firstName, rlr.middleName
Select object (o) from RefCourt AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.court.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefCourt AS o where o.refCourtId = ?1
Select object (o) FROM RefCourt o WHERE o.crestCode = ?1 and o.courtId = ?2
Select object (o) FROM RefCourt o WHERE o.isPsd = ?1 and o.courtId = ?2
Select object (o) from RefSystemCode AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.court.courtId = ?1
SELECT object (o) from RefSystemCode AS o WHERE NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.codeType = ?1 AND o.court.courtId = ?2
Select object (o) from RefJustice AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefCourtReporterFirm AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.courtId = ?1
Select object (o) from RefChamber AS o where NOT o.obsInd = 'Y' AND o.court.courtId = ?1 order by o.firmName
Select object (o) from RefChamber AS o WHERE o.crestChamberId = ?1 AND o.court.courtId = ?2 AND o.isGlobal = 'Y' order by o.firmName
Select object (o) from RefChamber AS o WHERE o.crestChamberId = ?1 AND o.court.courtId = ?2 AND o.isGlobal = 'Y' AND (o.obsInd is null OR o.obsInd = 'N' OR o.obsInd = ' ') order by o.firmName
Select distinct object (o) from RefChamber AS o WHERE UPPER (o.firmName) LIKE UPPER (?1) AND o.court.courtId = ?2 AND o.isGlobal = 'Y' order by o.firmName
Select distinct object (o) from RefChamber AS o WHERE UPPER (o.firmName) LIKE UPPER (?1) AND o.crestChamberId = ?2 AND o.court.courtId = ?3 AND o.isGlobal = 'Y' order by o.firmName
Select object (o) from Court AS o where o.shortName = ?1
Select object (o) from Court AS o

Select object (o) from CppFormatting AS o where o.courtId = ?1 and o.documentType = ?2 and o.creationDate >= ?3 and (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N') and (o.formatStatus IS NULL OR o.formatStatus <> 'MF') order by o.creationDate desc

Select object (o) from CppFormatting AS o where o.cppFormattingId =(select max(o2.cppFormattingId) from CppFormatting AS o2 where o2.courtId = ?1 and o2.documentType = ?3 and o2.dateIn >= ?2 and (o2.obsInd IS NULL OR o2.obsInd = 'N'))
Select object (o) from CppFormatting AS o where o.documentType = ?1 and o.formatStatus = 'ND' and o.creationDate >= ?2 order by o.creationDate
Select object (o) from CourtSite AS o where o.courtId = ?1

Select object (o) from CourtSite AS o where o.courtId = ?1 and (o.courtSiteCode='A' or o.courtSiteId in (select cs.courtSiteId from CourtSatellite cs where (cs.obsInd IS NULL OR cs.obsInd = 'N'))) and (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from CourtSite AS o where o.crestCourtId = ?1 and o.courtSiteCode = 'A' and (o.obsInd IS NULL OR o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from JudgeUsage AS o where o.courtRoomId = ?1 and o.sittingDate between ?2 and ?3 and (o.obsInd IS NULL or o.obsInd = 'N')
Select object (o) from CourtRoomUsage AS o where o.courtRoomId = ?1 and o.sittingDate between ?2 and ?3 and (o.obsInd IS NULL or o.obsInd = 'N')
